item.title: Damning report torpedoes Trump's 'central defense' about Epstein ties
item.description: A new report on Sunday torpedoed one of President Donald Trump's "central defenses" about his ties to convicted sex criminal Jeffrey Epstein. Trump has often claimed that he has never been credibly accused of wrongdoing over the course of his relationship with Epstein.
